policy.reason: V13 isolates the consolidated notification repair from installed V12 binaries. Android adds a private incoming-call activity for the locked-screen surface; iOS adds guarded native Answer readiness and an optional exact-call status observer. These native changes require fresh signed binaries and cannot be delivered by a V12 OTA. Existing Android 104 and iOS 38 artifacts, V12 digests and historical physical evidence remain immutable. Local source and synthetic/native checks do not establish installed notification, sound, moving-video or background-call behavior; the expanded paired physical matrix remains required. Future delivery stays limited to the existing Google Play internal track and TestFlight Chillywood Internal group. Native automatic activation remains disabled; the app owns update activation. This source generation grants no build, submission, server activation, OTA or public-release authority.
